[[File:Bio-Cube_Cities.png|thumb|right|275px|Bio-cube cities in the desert region of Mandalore]]
'''Bio-cubes''' were massive cube-shaped [[City/Legends|cities]] established amidst the devastated landscapes of [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]] and other [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] by the [[New Mandalorians/Legends|New Mandalorians]], following the [[Mandalorian Excision]] of [[738 BBY]]. The New Mandalorian [[Capital/Legends|capital]], [[Sundari/Legends|Sundari]], was an example of a bio-cube city.
